body_markdown:
*Wichita Falls, Texas-based credit union reports rapid member adoption and record digital engagement while laying the foundation of the full Digital Sales & Service Platform*


**November 3, 2026 (Plano, Texas)** – Alkami Technology, Inc. (Nasdaq: ALKT) (“Alkami”), a[digital sales and service platform provider](https://www.alkami.com/) for financial institutions in the U.S., today announced that[Texoma Community Credit Union](https://texomacu.com/) (Texoma) is expanding its relationship with Alkami to encompass the full Digital Sales & Service Platform. The[credit union is live](https://www.alkami.com/resources/client-success/client-story/texoma-community-credit-union-a-unified-launch-for-retail-and-business-banking/) with the Alkami Digital Banking Platform and is implementing MANTL Onboarding & Account Opening and Alkami’s Data & Marketing Solution.


Within two weeks of launching the new experience, more than 50% of the credit union’s members had adopted the Platform. In the first six months following the launch, Texoma’s online banking transactions increased 8.9% compared to the same period during the previous year, while online banking’s share of online, branch, and phone transactions rose from 53.0% to 67.8%.


“Was it worth us converting to a new digital platform? Absolutely. 100%. I would do it again,” said Angie Ohmstede, chief operating officer at Texoma Community Credit Union. “The launch has given us a strong foundation as we continue adding capabilities to create an even more connected digital experience for our members.”


With Alkami’s Digital Banking Platform now providing the foundation, MANTL Onboarding & Account Opening will support a more streamlined account opening journey, while Alkami’s Data & Marketing Solution will help Texoma use member insights to deliver more targeted campaigns and personalized communications. With the Digital Sales & Service Platform, Texoma will connect key moments across the member lifecycle, from opening an account to managing finances and building a deeper relationship with the credit union. The expansion supports Texoma’s goal of delivering the convenience and personalization members expect while preserving the local service and community focus that distinguish the credit union.


“Texoma is showing how a community-focused credit union can use a successful digital banking launch as a starting point for its evolving digital strategy,” said Benjamin Conant, chief product and technology officer at Alkami. “We are excited to support Texoma as it expands toward the connected Digital Sales & Service Platform, helping the credit union build on that momentum as its digital strategy evolves.”


To learn more about Anticipatory Banking and the Alkami Digital Sales & Service Platform, visit[here](https://www.alkami.com/anticipatory-banking/) .


**About Alkami**


[Alkami](https://www.alkami.com/press-room) provides a digital sales and service platform for U.S.[banks](https://www.alkami.com/banks/) and credit unions. Our unified Platform integrates onboarding, digital banking, and data and marketing—each solution can stand alone, but together they deliver more—to help institutions onboard, engage, and grow relationships. As the future shifts toward Anticipatory Banking, we help data-informed bankers meet the moment with technology that drives action.


**About Texoma Community Credit Union**


Since 1953, Texoma Community Credit Union is a democratically controlled financial cooperative that serves Wichita County and 18 surrounding counties. Because it is “not-for-profit, not-for-charity, but for service,” all income, after expenses and necessary reserves, is given back to our members in the form of lower fees, lower loan rates and higher deposit rates. Its mission is to build a community where everyone is given the tools to become RICH. (Ready, Independent, Charitable, and Happy). For more information, visit[www.texomacu.com](http://www.texomacu.com/) .
